title: Faros: Company Vision and Mission

hero.headline: We advance those who build
hero.subhead: We give engineering leaders visibility into how work operates across code, people, and systems, and control over how that work progresses through enforceable workflows and policy.

sections.heading: Our vision
sections.body: To forge a world where engineering moves at the speed of ideas.

sections.heading: Our values
sections.body: Transformational (long-term impact over short-term predictability), Intensity, Craftsmanship, Ownership (act like founders); transparency over politeness, honest debate over quiet agreement.

sections.heading: The story of Faros
sections.body: Founded by the founding team of Salesforce Einstein (first comprehensive enterprise AI platform), frustrated by the lack of data-backed narratives for engineering allocation decisions.

sections.heading: Leadership
sections.body: Vitaly Gordon (Founder & CEO), Shubha Nabar (Founder & Chief Scientist), Matthew Tovbin (Founder & CTO), Gilad Turbahn (Head of Product & Engineering), Thomas Gerber (Business Value Engineering), Dan Balter (Head of Business), Simanta Chakraborty (Head of Revenue), Dawn Bloomfield (Chief of Staff), Dhruv Gupta (Head of Marketing).

sections.heading: Investors
sections.body: Backed by Signal (likely SignalFire), Venture, GFC, Lobby, Operator Collective (logos shown, names partly inferred from alt-text).

notes: Confirms founders (ex-Salesforce Einstein) and the dual 'visibility AND control' framing — control via 'enforceable workflows and policy' is the public root of the Govern pillar. Vision 'engineering at the speed of ideas' is brandable provenance for an organization-level node. Investor names are partly inferred from SVG alt-text (logos only); flagged as low-confidence.
